lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is Tuesday's Board of County Commissioners meeting, where two Land Use Code amendments are up — one covering Natural Medicine Businesses and one on Nonconforming Lots, the kind of code language that quietly determines what gets built where for years to come. Wednesday brings the county's sixth working session on its housing code rewrite, digging into zoning, density, and regulatory incentives for workforce housing with final recommendations taking shape. HARC meets Tuesday as well, with the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave going through preliminary large-scale public hearings across eight buildings.
